p: This documentation will grow alongside Materiaal. For now, it provides a simple home for essential information and official brand assets.
Download official Materiaal logos and icons for use in media, partnerships, and other communications.
We back athletes and teams who will put Materiaal wheels to work. The goals are simple:
6 to 8 wheelsets, with a mix of tubular and tubeless.
An allocation based on the team's disciplines, rider count, and race program.

Don't see the wheels you need in our current range? Please get in touch as we may have wheels in development or be able to develop a wheelset specifically for your requirements. Riders in other disciplines are welcome to get in touch, too. We will do our best to assist.
See the Your sponsored wheels section for renewal and return details.
We can tailor each allocation to your requirements and goals.
We provide wheels for your use during an initial sponsorship term of up to two years. Ownership of the wheels remains with Materiaal, Inc.

The team manages its wheel allocations amongst its riders, keeps track of the wheels, and provides one main point of contact. We agree on wheel requirements and service arrangements together. If a rider leaves, their wheels stay with the team for reassignment or eventual return to Materiaal, Inc.
Race hard. Put the wheels to work in training and competition. They are built for the demands of racing.
Provide honest feedback. Tell us what works, what doesn't, and what you would change to help us build better wheels
Represent yourself professionally. Treat fellow riders, race officials, volunteers, and supporters with respect, on and off the course.
Treat the materiaal 😉 with respect. Keep the wheels maintained, follow setup instructions, and report problems promptly.
Ride Materiaal exclusively. Use Materiaal wheels for training and racing in the disciplines and seasons we agree to sponsor.
Work with us patiently and professionally. If something goes wrong, we work together on a solution.
For individual athletes, there are no social media requirements. Any additional team commitments are discussed before the sponsorship begins.
With your permission, we’ll feature you on our Athletes page and capture photos and videos of you racing for use on our website, social media and other marketing channels.
Sponsored wheels receive support under the Materiaal Race Ready Limited Warranty policy, with one key difference:
During your sponsorship term, eligible accidental damage repairs and replacements have no product charge and no preset limit on incidents. You will have full no-fault repair or replacement support.

If a wheel is damaged, stop using it and contact us with photos and the wheel ID or rim barcode. We will work to resolve the issue quickly, keep you informed, and do our absolute best to minimize disruption to your racing.
All sponsored wheels and replacements remain the property of Materiaal, Inc. Do not sell, give away, or pass them outside the agreed allocation without our approval.
The initial term is up to two years.
After two years, if the partnership is working well and we both agree to continue, we exchange your current wheels for new wheels and begin a new sponsorship term.
If your plans change or the sponsorship ends, we arrange the return of the wheels with you.
An introduction to you or your team, including where you are based.
Your discipline and race plans for the upcoming year or season.
Your bike(s), drivetrain spec, wheel requirements, and any existing sponsor arrangements that might be conflicting.
Any additional information you would like to let us know about.
For riders under 18, we involve a parent or guardian in the sponsorship arrangement.

Use the My Cycling Vlaanderen portal to register for cyclocross races in Belgium, typically C1 and C2 races, and manage your rider details. You must be known to Cycling Vlaanderen to sign in. Foreign licence holders can create an account through the portal.
